art_direction: Nighttime black / muted sepia / amber; readable characters; restrained background.
motion_and_audio_status: Proposed scene-specific briefs; not rendered for these ten scenes.

entries.title: The Midnight Cauldron
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Slow spoon arc, occasional blinks, candle flicker, sparse rising bubbles that fade before wrapping.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Warm low organ/pad, restrained bubbling texture, soft fire-like noise; keep high-frequency fizz subdued.

entries.title: Tea at the Witch's Door
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Tiny kettle tilt, looping steam wisp, cat blink; keep chair, door and ground still.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Gentle organ and sparse rounded tines, warm room/forest air, quiet tea steam texture; relaxed and intimate.

entries.title: The Graveyard Gardener
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Small watering-can tilt, sparse water droplets with fade, flower sway and lantern flicker.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Soft low choir and distant strings, delicate water-like texture, sparse muted bell accents with long tails.

entries.title: The Ghost Ferry
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Boat rises and falls a few pixels, cloth sways, reflection ripples and mist drifts; no endless forward travel.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Deep smooth drone, slow formant choir, quiet water lapping and low wind; wide space without sharp splashes.

entries.title: The Raven Archivist
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Raven blinks and dips beak slightly, page corner breathes, candle flickers; book text stays indistinct.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Dark rounded organ, low string layer, very soft paper-like noise; avoid repetitive page-flip impacts.

entries.title: The Toad's Apothecary
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Small vial tilt, a slow steam ribbon, occasional toad blink and gentle bowl glow.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Soft bubbling bed, rounded plucked/tine accents, low pad; damp and curious rather than comic or percussive.

entries.title: The Fox at the Crossroads
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Scarf and tail sway, lantern swing and flicker; fox remains planted at the crossroads.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Broad quiet wind, sparse forest-leaf texture, warm sustained strings and pad; no recurring footsteps.

entries.title: The Little Bell Keeper
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Small rope/arm motion and restrained bell sway, candle flicker; mouse feet stay on the step.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Very sparse low bell partials with long decay over a dark pad and low wind; avoid a regular loud toll.

entries.title: The Moth Collector
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Antennae sway, a tiny moth orbits inside jar, folded wings breathe, glow changes gently.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Airy formant pad, sparse high softened harmonics and quiet wing-like filtered noise; no bright jingles.

entries.title: The Pumpkin Watchman
entries.suggested_visual_loop: Scarecrow feet and cloth sway slightly, pumpkin light flickers; fence and tree remain static.
entries.suggested_audio_palette: Hollow organ, low autumn wind, subdued creaking texture and warm bass; no jump-scare transients.
